The center stays a calm medium-light brick-red color field, brighter than the foreground demon's navy and black outlines. Avoid making it a pale spotlight or dark hole. Background boundaries use medium colors from the red palette, never black or near-black ink. Keep the center empty of detail so tiny common and wide mythic demons both remain visible.
